integrity_note: Proof uses exact all-index parity lifts from the paperfolding recurrence; the accompanying finite program is reproducibility support and is not an infinite proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the ordinary binary paperfolding word at all lengths \(2^k\) with \(k\ge2\); no assertion for arbitrary paperfolding words, other lengths, or higher binomial order. No independent mathematical audit has been completed.
title: Dyadic 2-binomial complexity of the ordinary paperfolding word
